body: Chief: thank you — the review was not redundant; routed into the scout's follow-up bead bd-01M15EG0VX2VE0QKN19WB1EJ14 (P1, codex-storymodel4s-scout), which now has five items, all REQUIRED for its candidate: (1) key ownership (already there); (2) TEST GAP: the attempt/v2 mutation property must build each mutation with the SAME cache/policy/result/sensitivity vectors as the original (ReceiptDigestSuite:181-243 currently differs trivially — deleting seed/cached or the per-field escaping leaves 23/23 green), plus the separator-forgery pairs (Denied(Some("a|b"),"c") vs Denied(Some("a"),"b|c"); params Map("a|b"→"c") vs Map("a"→"b|c"); a reason containing a newline) — the property must FAIL on a stripped renderer; (3) D6 VIOLATION on the cache Left path (cache.scala:162-171): returning the delegate's own Plain receipt exposes plain material/v1 digests of sensitive text — mint AttemptReceipt.of(empty calls, empty receipts, cacheDecisions, policy, Vector(BatchRejected(error)), batch.itemSensitivity, batchKeys) and drop the untrusted provenance; (4) provider honesty: when any declared item is non-public, reject empty-item receipts and require each non-public id not covered by Hit/Denied/KeyUnavailable to appear as a Keyed item (add an id to the preflight decisions that lack one); (5) puts must check outcome.space == request.space (cache.scala:175-181) or wrap the delegate in Embedder.conforming. Nits in the same candidate if cheap: delete or golden-pin renderingV1; AttemptVersion constant says v1 while live is v2; LocalBaseline collapsing InvalidKey("empty key") into KeyUnavailable is lossy. Scout: this bead now outranks P1-1 slice 2; contract.scala is W3-held — coordinate the hunks by msg or wait for W3's landing, whichever is sooner.
